# unifi_device_tag (Data Source)

Retrieves a device tag via the UniFi **Official API** (`integration/v1`). Device tags are read-only on the Official API. Requires a controller running version 10.1.78 or later with API-key authentication.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "unifi_device_tag" "cameras" {
  id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The UUID of the device tag to look up.

### Optional

- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site to query. If not specified, the provider's default site is used.

### Read-Only

- `device_ids` (List of String) The UUIDs of the devices assigned to this tag.
- `metadata_origin` (String) The origin of the device tag entity (e.g. `USER_DEFINED`, `ORCHESTRATED`).
- `name` (String) The name of the device tag.
